description: Changes an active or paused subscription: amount, description, schedule (interval, every, dayOfMonth, nextRunAt), customer, maxRuns, reminders, metadata. Only the fields passed change. Cancelled or finished subscriptions cannot be changed.

amount.description: Amount in KZT per run; whole tenge for kind="phone"

email.description: Gets the pay link by email on each live run

description.description: Shown to the customer, e.g. "Gym pass — October"

kind.description: "qr" (default: pay link, emailed if customer.email) or "phone" (invoice pushed into the customer's Kaspi.kz app)

maxRuns.description: Stop after N invoices; omit for no end

metadata.description: Copied into every invoice and webhook

nextRunAt.description: ISO date/time of the next invoice

reminders.description: Customer reminders: N days before each invoice, and after an unpaid one

name: qutpay_update_subscription
title: Update a subscription
